title: Fluid Templates, Partials and Layouts
hints: Template files carry the .fluid.html extension. The bare .html form is legacy: at TYPO3 v14 the core has 617 .fluid.html files under typo3/sysext/*/Resources/Private against 3 remaining .html ones.

Only the f: and core: namespaces are available without declaring them: they are registered globally through Configuration/Fluid/Namespaces.php (fluid registers f: for TYPO3Fluid\Fluid\ViewHelpers and TYPO3\CMS\Fluid\ViewHelpers, core registers core: for TYPO3\CMS\Core\ViewHelpers, form registers formvh:).

Every other namespace is declared per template, including the backend one: xmlns:be="http://typo3.org/ns/TYPO3/CMS/Backend/ViewHelpers" on the root element, together with data-namespace-typo3-fluid="true" so the declaration is stripped from the rendered output.
A backend module resolves templates through the templateRootPaths of its view factory, so a partial is referenced by its name below Resources/Private/Partials, never by a file path.
Fluid escapes output by default. Do not work around it in the template; if a ViewHelper has to return markup, that decision belongs in the ViewHelper via escapeOutput.
Use typo3_component_lookup for the markup of a backend component and typo3_icon_lookup for an icon identifier instead of writing either from memory.

title: ViewHelpers
hints: The current shape is a final class extending AbstractViewHelper with initializeArguments(): void declaring every argument through registerArgument(), and a typed render(): string. Dependencies are constructor-injected.

renderStatic() and the CompileWithRenderStatic trait are deprecated since 13.3 (Deprecation-104789-RenderStaticForFluidViewHelpers.rst) and must not be used in new code. No core ViewHelper carries them any more; the only remaining mentions are the changelog and the extension scanner matcher.

Set protected bool $escapeOutput = false when the ViewHelper returns markup, and $escapeChildren = false when its children are markup rather than text. Both are opt-outs from Fluid's default escaping, so state why in the class docblock.

ViewHelpers are covered by functional tests under Tests/Functional/ViewHelpers/, not unit tests: at TYPO3 v14 the core has 85 functional ViewHelper test classes against 2 unit ones. A ViewHelper needs a rendering context, so a unit test asserts the wrong thing.
A ViewHelper is public API. A new one, or a changed argument list, needs a changelog entry under typo3/sysext/core/Documentation/Changelog/.

Fluid parsing itself is configured in $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['SYS']['fluid'] in typo3/sysext/core/Configuration/DefaultConfiguration.php — interceptors, preProcessors including NamespaceDetectionTemplateProcessor, and expressionNodeTypes.
